note: Single source of truth for visual identity. The Creative Engine, lead-magnet assets, and all generated creatives MUST read tokens from this file. Do not hardcode hex values anywhere else.

display.role: Headlines, hero copy, emphasis. Serif. Editorial, premium.
display.italic_use: Gold-colored italic at weight 300 is the signature emphasis treatment.

ui.role: Body, UI, paragraphs, buttons. Sans-serif. Clean, modern.

mono.role: Labels, eyebrows, metadata, code, data tags. Uppercase + wide tracking.
mono.treatment: letter-spacing 0.15em-0.35em, text-transform uppercase, gold or muted color

do: Gold-on-ink and ink-on-cream are the two primary contrast pairings.
Use generous negative space. Premium, not crowded.
Radial gold glow on dark backgrounds for atmosphere.
Italic Fraunces in gold for the single most important word in a headline.
Real photography of furnished units beats AI-rendered interiors where available.
dont: No purple gradients, no generic SaaS-blue, no stock-photo gloss.
No fonts outside the three above.
No AI-generated talking-head / fake-testimonial UGC video (see DECISIONS.md D-03).
No itemized markup shown to client (locked RevAtelier rule applies to setup-fee framing).

before_after_split.use: Before/after unit transformation, vertical or horizontal split
